test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Article related to compulsory acquisition of property has been omitted now from the Indian constitution. What is the number of this article?
solution:
The correct answer is __**31.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 31:-**

 
 
• Article 31 which contained the right to property was abolished.
 
• It is still a constitutional right but not a Fundamental Right.
 
 
 
• **Constitution of India:-**
 
 
• It took** 2 years, 11months, 18 days** to be written.

 It is the** lengthtiest written constitution i**n the world.
 
• **Dr. B. R. Ambedkar** is known as the** Father of the Indian Constitution.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Article 31 A of the Constitution of India, speaks about the acquisition of estates.
 
• Article 31B states that the acts which are present in the ninth schedule and are inconsistent with the provisions laid down by the constitution or resist any decree or order will be left on the competent legislature to amend, revoke, or to let it be in force.
 
• **Article 31 D** mentioned about Saving of laws in respect of anti-national activities.
